intro.title: Contests
intro.subtitle: Where our students shine
intro.description: From photography to storytelling, our contests celebrate the many talents of Albayan students.

items.title: QND Contest 2025
items.excerpt: Qatar National Day photography contest — celebrating Qatar through our students' eyes.
items.body:
The Qatar National Day Photography Contest invited students to capture the spirit of Qatar National Day.

We received over 20 submissions from students across all grades. Congratulations to everyone who participated!

items.title: Albayan Author 2025
items.excerpt: Original stories written and illustrated by our Grade 3 and Grade 4 students.
items.body:
The Albayan Author program gives our youngest writers a chance to become published authors. Each student writes, illustrates, and binds their own original story.

Every story is a treasure. We are so proud of our young writers!
